in_sanskrit.name: राँगित
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has colors, or the one who is colorful. This name could be derived from the Sanskrit word 'ranga' meaning color.

in_hindi.name: राँगित
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who has colors, or the one who is colorful.

in_tamil.name: ராங்கித்
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who has colors, or the one who is colorful.

in_telugu.name: రాంగిట్
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who is worshipped by the God of Colors (Ranganatha).

in_marathi.name: Rangit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rangit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Rangit means 'one who is full of joy and radiates it'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'rang' meaning 'color'.

in_bengali.name: Rangit
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Joy, Radiance
in_bengali.long_meaning: Rangit একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Rangit means 'one who is full of joy and radiates it'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'rang' meaning 'color'.
